main.description: 債務者が rite に opt-in し、eligibility proof を提出する。**Debtor MUST be a natural person (自然人) — legal-person debt is out of scope.** rite type 別の eligibility 条件 (shmita = 共同体員、tokusei = jurisdictionMatch 等) は verifyEligibility で評価。

debtorEntityType.description: MUST be 'natural_person'. yobel releases debt for individuals only — legal-person debt (sovereign / corporate restructuring) is out of scope. Single-value enum makes the natural-person-only invariant schema-enforced. Verified against the debtor's CouncilSBT entityType claim by debtor_enrollment cell DMN R14 short-circuit.

eligibilityProof.description: Free-text or signed claim supporting eligibility (community membership card, residence cert, trust kyu/dan ref)
